quests.spatialHierarchy: Enclosed Space / Volume (e.g. in the room)
quests.question: My notebook is ___ my backpack, along with my pens.
quests.targetSentence: My notebook is in my backpack, along with my pens.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'In' is used when something is enclosed inside a space, like a backpack, a box, or a drawer.
quests.nativeTip: Something fully enclosed inside a container calls for this word.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'in' (Enclosed Space / Volume (e.g. in the room)) ➔ 'My notebook is in my backpack, along with my pens.'

quests.question: There's a coffee stain ___ the carpet.
quests.targetSentence: There's a coffee stain on the carpet.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'On' describes contact with a surface — a stain sits on the carpet, not inside it.
quests.nativeTip: Think about contact with a flat surface, not something enclosed.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'on' (Surface Contact (e.g. on the table)) ➔ 'There's a coffee stain on the carpet.'

quests.question: Turn left ___ the traffic light.
quests.targetSentence: Turn left at the traffic light.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'At' marks a precise point in space, such as a traffic light, a doorway, or a corner.
quests.nativeTip: This word marks an exact point, not a wide area.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'at' (Specific Point (e.g. at the door)) ➔ 'Turn left at the traffic light.'

quests.question: The recycling bin sits ___ the kitchen sink, tucked inside the cabinet there.
quests.targetSentence: The recycling bin sits under the kitchen sink, tucked inside the cabinet there.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Under' shows a position directly below something else. The mention of the cabinet confirms the bin is beneath the sink, not next to it.
quests.nativeTip: The clue about the cabinet tells you this is a lower position, not beside the sink.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'under' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'The recycling bin sits under the kitchen sink, tucked inside the cabinet there.'

quests.question: The spice rack is mounted on the wall, ___ the stove, just below the extractor fan.
quests.targetSentence: The spice rack is mounted on the wall, above the stove, just below the extractor fan.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Above' fits because the rack sits higher than the stove yet still under the fan — 'next to' wouldn't match that vertical description.
quests.nativeTip: It's positioned higher than the stove but lower than the fan.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'above' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'The spice rack is mounted on the wall, above the stove, just below the extractor fan.'

quests.question: The bread box sits ___ the toaster, both on the kitchen counter.
quests.targetSentence: The bread box sits next to the toaster, both on the kitchen counter.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Next to' means directly beside something, with nothing in between — here, two items sharing the same counter.
quests.nativeTip: They're on the same surface, side by side.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'next to' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'The bread box sits next to the toaster, both on the kitchen counter.'

quests.question: My backpack is ___ my chair, hanging on a hook.
quests.targetSentence: My backpack is behind my chair, hanging on a hook.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Behind' places something at the back of another object, like a bag hanging behind a chair.
quests.nativeTip: Picture the back of the chair, not the front or the side.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'behind' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'My backpack is behind my chair, hanging on a hook.'

quests.question: The whiteboard is ___ the students' desks, so everyone can see it while writing notes.
quests.targetSentence: The whiteboard is in front of the students' desks, so everyone can see it while writing notes.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'In front of' means positioned before or facing something — the class faces the whiteboard while it's positioned ahead of them.
quests.nativeTip: This is the opposite of 'behind'.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'in front of' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'The whiteboard is in front of the students' desks, so everyone can see it while writing notes.'

quests.question: A tall bookshelf stands ___ the classroom door.
quests.targetSentence: A tall bookshelf stands beside the classroom door.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Beside' means at the side of something, close to it — here, a bookshelf next to the door.
quests.nativeTip: Right at the side, similar to 'next to'.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'beside' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'A tall bookshelf stands beside the classroom door.'

quests.question: There's a pharmacy ___ the train station, about a five-minute walk away.
quests.targetSentence: There's a pharmacy near the train station, about a five-minute walk away.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Near' shows something is close in distance without touching or being right next to it — a short walk still counts as near.
quests.nativeTip: Close by, though not necessarily right beside it.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'near' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'There's a pharmacy near the train station, about a five-minute walk away.'

quests.question: The mailbox stands ___ two tall lampposts.
quests.targetSentence: The mailbox stands between two tall lampposts.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Between' describes a position with one thing on each side — here, a lamppost on either side of the mailbox.
quests.nativeTip: This word needs exactly two things, one on each side.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'between' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'The mailbox stands between two tall lampposts.'

quests.question: Several food trucks were parked ___ the square, facing in every direction.
quests.targetSentence: Several food trucks were parked around the square, facing in every direction.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Around' shows a position surrounding something, like trucks scattered on all sides of a square.
quests.nativeTip: Think of things scattered on every side of a central spot.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'around' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'Several food trucks were parked around the square, facing in every direction.'

quests.question: The manager's office is ___ the store, past the fitting rooms.
quests.targetSentence: The manager's office is inside the store, past the fitting rooms.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Inside' emphasizes being within the interior of a place, such as an office located within a store.
quests.nativeTip: This describes the interior of the building, not its entrance.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'inside' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'The manager's office is inside the store, past the fitting rooms.'

quests.question: A line of customers was waiting ___ the shop, right by the door, before it opened.
quests.targetSentence: A line of customers was waiting outside the shop, right by the door, before it opened.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'Outside' places something beyond the boundary of a building. The detail 'right by the door' confirms it's not just somewhere nearby.
quests.nativeTip: The opposite of 'inside' — beyond the building's walls.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'outside' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'A line of customers was waiting outside the shop, right by the door, before it opened.'

quests.question: The discounted items are ___ the bottom shelf.
quests.targetSentence: The discounted items are on the bottom shelf.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'On' is used for items resting on a surface, such as a shelf.
quests.nativeTip: A shelf is a surface, not an enclosed space.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'on' (Surface Contact (e.g. on the table)) ➔ 'The discounted items are on the bottom shelf.'

quests.question: Please check in ___ the front desk when you arrive.
quests.targetSentence: Please check in at the front desk when you arrive.
quests.ruleExplanation: 'At' marks a specific point of reference, such as a reception desk where visitors check in.
quests.nativeTip: This word treats the desk as a specific point, not a surface or a container.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'at' (Specific Point (e.g. at the door)) ➔ 'Please check in at the front desk when you arrive.'

quests.question: The bus shelter is ___ the newsstand, hidden from anyone walking straight up the street.

quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'behind' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'The bus shelter is behind the newsstand, hidden from anyone walking straight up the street.'

quests.question: I always stand ___ the ticket machine while I wait for the train.
quests.targetSentence: I always stand next to the ticket machine while I wait for the train.

quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'next to' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'I always stand next to the ticket machine while I wait for the train.'

quests.question: We sheltered ___ the station's glass canopy during the rain.

quests.ruleExplanation: 'Under' describes being beneath something that covers or shelters you, like a canopy.
quests.nativeTip: A canopy covers you from above, so you'd be positioned beneath it.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'under' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'We sheltered under the station's glass canopy during the rain.'

quests.question: A row of flags flew ___ the entrance gate.

quests.nativeTip: Flags on tall poles are usually higher than a gate, not touching it.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'above' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'A row of flags flew above the entrance gate.'

quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'between' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'A narrow path runs between the pond and the playground.'

quests.question: Tourists often take photos ___ the old fountain.

quests.question: She left her umbrella ___ the coat rack.

quests.ruleExplanation: 'Beside' shows the umbrella positioned right next to the coat rack.

quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'beside' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'She left her umbrella beside the coat rack.'

quests.question: Small candles were placed ___ the table for the birthday dinner.

quests.question: The security guard's desk is ___ the main entrance, right where visitors sign in.

quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'at' (Specific Point (e.g. at the door)) ➔ 'The security guard's desk is at the main entrance, right where visitors sign in.'

quests.question: The old oak tree stands ___ our house, so close its branches touch the roof.
quests.targetSentence: The old oak tree stands next to our house, so close its branches touch the roof.

quests.nativeTip: The detail about touching branches shows real closeness, not just general nearness.
quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'next to' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'The old oak tree stands next to our house, so close its branches touch the roof.'

quests.question: The children's playground is ___ the school and the public library, an easy walk from both.

quests.visualAnchor: 🧭 Preposition 'between' (Direction & Spatial Relationship) ➔ 'The children's playground is between the school and the public library, an easy walk from both.'
